thread:
maya: Following the RCA yesterday — we need to lock owners and a short timeline for the remediation bundle. Recurring throughput regressions (observed 3x in 8 days) so treat this as P1 reliability work + quick mitigations. I'll propose tickets below.

raj: I can take the metric tagging and alert tuning (INF-3801). Plan: add histogram buckets, reduce noisy paging, and add an incident throttle flag. ETA Thu.

ellie: I'll own the fast rollback and per-model rate limits (INF-3802). Deliverable: a safe toggle and docs for SRE to flip during bursts.

ben: What's the required coverage for Dedicated/private? Need to avoid splitting effort too thin.

maya: Start with hosted (critical path), then add Dedicated/private as a follow-up (INF-3803). We'll parent them under epic INF-3800.

oncall-bot: Alert trend detected: elevated tail latency on 2026-03-02, 2026-03-07, 2026-03-10. Suggested action: audit runbook and add pre-burst mitigations.

tori: I can do the runbook updates (INF-3804). Will draft playbook steps: identify burst, activate rate limits, notify product owners. ETA Fri.

raj: For INF-3801 I'll add a quick test harness. Repro command to simulate tail load:
```bash
python tools/sim_burst.py --model test-agg --qps 120 --duration 3m
```
Will attach results to the postmortem doc.

ellie: Rollback plan: feature flag + traffic-splitper threshold. Proposing canary 10% -> 50% -> full with 15m checks. If latency regresses by >20% revert.

ben: Suggest adding an automated fallback route to a lower-cost/safer model family while we investigate; reduces user impact. Could be INF-3805.

maya: Good idea. Add INF-3805 for fallback routing; assign to @ben. Also set due dates: canary runtime fix in 10 business days, Dedicated follow-on in 18 business days.

tori: RACI for the bundle: R: @ellie (rollback+limits), @raj (metrics/alerts); A: @maya; C: @ben; I: @tori, @oncall-bot.

ellie: I'll open PR drafts today and include a checklist: unit tests, canary config, rollback steps, doc changes.

raj: I'll post benchmarking scripts and baseline numbers under the postmortem page. Quick note for reproducibility: include seed and payload files.

maya: Weekly check-in: Fridays 9am PT. I'll create the recurring event and update the postmortem page with ticket links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3800 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3801 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3802 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3805

ben: :thumbsup: I'll start a draft for the fallback routing design and tag infra for input.

tori: I'll add a remediation tracker table to the doc and include owners + due dates so we can close the loop.

maya: Thanks. Actionables recap in the doc: INF-3800 (epic), INF-3801 (metrics/alerts) - @raj - Thu, INF-3802 (rollback & limits) - @ellie - 10bd, INF-3804 (runbook) - @tori - Fri, INF-3805 (fallback routing) - @ben - 2w. I'll ping tomorrow after tickets exist. :white_check_mark:
